            'Future<void> _showV2ReopenClosedCase(\n'
            '  BuildContext context,\n'
            '  V2Student student,\n'
            '  V2FocusItem item,\n'
            ') async {\n'
            '  final runtime = _V2RuntimeScope.maybeOf(context);\n'
            '  final controller = runtime?.workflowController;\n'
            '  if (controller == null || !controller.canReopenClosedCase(item.id)) {\n'
            '    return;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  V2ReopenDraftSnapshot? pendingDraft;\n'
            '  try {\n'
            '    pendingDraft = await controller.loadPendingReopen(item.id);\n'
            '  } catch (error) {\n'
            '    if (!context.mounted) return;\n'
            '    final message = error is V2WorkflowSaveException\n'
            '        ? error.userMessage\n'
            '        : \'上次未完成的重新跟进暂时无法恢复，请重试。\';\n'
            '    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)\n'
            '        .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message)));\n'
            '    return;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '  if (!context.mounted) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '  final saved = await showV2ReopenCaseComposer(\n'
            '    context,\n'
            '    studentName: student.name,\n'
            '    subject: item.subject,\n'
            '    caseTitle: item.title,\n'
            '    businessDate: controller.businessDate,\n'
            '    pendingDraft: pendingDraft,\n'
            '    onSave: (draft) => controller.reopenClosedCase(\n'
            '      V2ReopenWrite(\n'
            '        caseId: item.id,\n'
            '        recurrenceSummary: draft.recurrenceSummary,\n'
            '        nextActionTitle: draft.nextActionTitle,\n'
            '        nextActionDueOn: draft.nextActionDueOn,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '  );\n'
            '  if (saved && context.mounted) {\n'
            '    runtime?.onWorkspaceChanged?.call();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'

            '                    ? null\n'
            '                    : () => Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(false),\n'
            '                child: const Text(\'取消\'),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              FilledButton(\n'
            '                key: const Key(\'v2-confirm-void-case\'),\n'
            '                onPressed: saving\n'
            '                    ? null\n'
            '                    : () async {\n'
            '                        setDialogState(() {\n'
            '                          saving = true;\n'
            '                          errorText = null;\n'
            '                        });\n'
            '                        try {\n'
            '                          await controller.voidCase(\n'
            '                            operationId: operationId,\n'
            '                            caseId: item.id,\n'
            '                            reason: selectedReason,\n'
            '                            note: noteController.text,\n'
            '                          );\n'
            '                          if (dialogContext.mounted) {\n'
            '                            Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(true);\n'
            '                          }\n'
            '                        } on V2WorkflowSaveException catch (error) {\n'
            '                          if (dialogContext.mounted) {\n'
            '                            setDialogState(() {\n'
            '                              saving = false;\n'
            '                              errorText = error.userMessage;\n'
            '                            });\n'
            '                          }\n'
            '                        } catch (_) {\n'
            '                          if (dialogContext.mounted) {\n'
            '                            setDialogState(() {\n'
            '                              saving = false;\n'
            '                              errorText = \'这条学情暂时无法作废，请稍后重试。\';\n'
            '                            });\n'
            '                          }\n'
            '                        }\n'
            '                      },\n'
            '                child: saving\n'
            '                    ? const SizedBox(\n'
            '                        width: 18,\n'
            '                        height: 18,\n'
            '                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),\n'
            '                      )\n'
            '                    : const Text(\'确认作废\'),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      },\n'
            '    );\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (removed == true && context.mounted) {\n'
            '      runtime?.onWorkspaceChanged?.call();\n'
            '      return true;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return false;\n'
            '  } finally {\n'
            '    noteController.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Future<void> _showV2VoidedCasesForStudent(\n'
            '  BuildContext context,\n'
            '  V2Student student,\n'
            ') async {\n'
            '  final controller = _V2RuntimeScope.maybeOf(context)?.workflowController;\n'
            '  if (controller == null) return;\n'
            '  final compact = ResponsiveBreakpoints.isCompact(context);\n'
            '  final content = _V2VoidedCasesView(\n'
            '    student: student,\n'
            '    controller: controller,\n'
            '    onChanged: _V2RuntimeScope.maybeOf(context)?.onWorkspaceChanged,\n'
            '  );\n'
            '  if (compact) {\n'
            '    await showModalBottomSheet<void>(\n'
            '      context: context,\n'
            '      useSafeArea: true,\n'
            '      showDragHandle: true,\n'
            '      isScrollControlled: true,\n'
            '      builder: (_) => FractionallySizedBox(heightFactor: 0.82, child: content),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  } else {\n'
            '    await showDialog<void>(\n'
            '      context: context,\n'
            '      builder: (_) =>\n'
            '          Dialog(child: SizedBox(width: 620, height: 600, child: content)),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _V2VoidedCasesView extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _V2VoidedCasesView({\n'
            '    required this.student,\n'
            '    required this.controller,\n'
            '    this.onChanged,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2Student student;\n'
            '  final V2WorkflowController controller;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onChanged;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_V2VoidedCasesView> createState() => _V2VoidedCasesViewState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _V2VoidedCasesViewState extends State<_V2VoidedCasesView> {\n'
            '  late Future<List<V2VoidedCaseItem>> _future;\n'
            '  String? _errorText;\n'
            '  String? _restoringCaseId;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    _future = widget.controller.listVoidedCasesForStudent(widget.student.id);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _reload() {\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _errorText = null;\n'
            '      _future = widget.controller.listVoidedCasesForStudent(widget.student.id);\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  String _dateLabel(DateTime value) =>\n'
            '      \'${value.year}-${value.month.toString().padLeft(2, \'0\')}-${value.day.toString().padLeft(2, \'0\')}\';\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _restore(V2VoidedCaseItem item) async {\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _restoringCaseId = item.caseId;\n'
            '      _errorText = null;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await widget.controller.restoreVoidedCase(\n'
            '        operationId: createOperationId(),\n'
            '        item: item,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      widget.onChanged?.call();\n'
            '      if (mounted) _reload();\n'
            '    } on V2WorkflowSaveException catch (error) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _errorText = error.userMessage);\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _errorText = \'这条学情暂时无法恢复，请稍后重试。\');\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _restoringCaseId = null);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final canRestore = widget.controller.workspace.canManageOrganization;\n'
            '    return SafeArea(\n'
            '      child: Padding(\n'
            '        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 18, 20, 18),\n'
            '        child: Column(\n'
            '          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '          children: [\n'
            '            Row(\n'
            '              children: [\n'
            '                Expanded(\n'
            '                  child: Column(\n'
            '                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                    children: [\n'
            '                      Text(\n'
            '                        \'已作废学情\',\n'
            '                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '                      Text(\n'
            '                        \'${widget.student.name} · 错误或重复档案\',\n'
            '                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                IconButton(\n'
            '                  tooltip: \'关闭\',\n'
            '                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),\n'
            '                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 10),\n'
            '            Text(\n'
            '              canRestore\n'
            '                  ? \'作废只隐藏错误档案，不会删除成长记录。负责人或管理员可以恢复。\'\n'
            '                  : \'作废只隐藏错误档案，不会删除成长记录；如需恢复，请联系负责人或管理员。\',\n'
            '              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            if (_errorText != null) ...[\n'
            '              const SizedBox(height: 10),\n'
            '              Text(\n'
            '                _errorText!,\n'
            '                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall\n'
            '                    ?.copyWith(color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '            Expanded(\n'
            '              child: FutureBuilder<List<V2VoidedCaseItem>>(\n'
            '                future: _future,\n'
            '                builder: (context, snapshot) {\n'
            '                  if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {\n'
            '                    return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());\n'
            '                  }\n'
            '                  if (snapshot.hasError) {\n'
            '                    return Center(\n'
            '                      child: Column(\n'
            '                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '                        children: [\n'
            '                          const Text(\'已作废学情暂时无法读取。\'),\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(height: 10),\n'
            '                          OutlinedButton(\n'
            '                            onPressed: _reload,\n'
            '                            child: const Text(\'重试\'),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    );\n'
            '                  }\n'
            '                  final items = snapshot.data ?? const <V2VoidedCaseItem>[];\n'
            '                  if (items.isEmpty) {\n'
            '                    return Center(\n'
            '                      child: Text(\n'
            '                        \'没有已作废学情\',\n'
            '                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    );\n'
            '                  }\n'
            '                  return ListView.separated(\n'
            '                    itemCount: items.length,\n'
            '                    separatorBuilder: (_, _) => Divider(\n'
            '                      height: 1,\n'
            '                      color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outlineVariant,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {\n'
            '                      final item = items[index];\n'
            '                      final restoring = _restoringCaseId == item.caseId;\n'
            '                      return ListTile(\n'
            '                        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,\n'
            '                        title: Text(item.title),\n'
            '                        subtitle: Text(\n'
            '                          \'${item.subject} · ${item.reasonLabel}\\n${item.voidedByName} · ${_dateLabel(item.voidedAt)}${item.note == null ? \'\' : \'\\n${item.note}\'}\',\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                        isThreeLine: item.note != null,\n'
            '                        trailing: canRestore\n'
            '                            ? TextButton(\n'
            '                                key: ValueKey<String>(\n'
            '                                  \'v2-restore-${item.caseId}\',\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                                onPressed: restoring\n'
            '                                    ? null\n'
            '                                    : () => _restore(item),\n'
            '                                child: restoring\n'
            '                                    ? const SizedBox(\n'
            '                                        width: 16,\n'
            '                                        height: 16,\n'
            '                                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(\n'
            '                                          strokeWidth: 2,\n'
            '                                        ),\n'
            '                                      )\n'
            '                                    : const Text(\'恢复\'),\n'
            '                              )\n'
            '                            : null,\n'
            '                      );\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  );\n'
            '                },\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Future<void> _showV2ProgressForCase(\n'
            '  BuildContext context,\n'
            '  V2Student student,\n'
            '  V2FocusItem item, {\n'
            '  ComposerDraftSnapshot? initialDraft,\n'
            '  bool completeCurrentActionInitially = false,\n'
            '  V2QuickCaptureDraft? transferredObservation,\n'
            '}) async {\n'
            '  final runtime = _V2RuntimeScope.maybeOf(context);\n'
            '  final controller = runtime?.workflowController;\n'
            '  final storedOperationId = initialDraft?.state[\'operation_id\'];\n'
            '  final storedPhotoOperationId =\n'
            '      initialDraft?.state[\'photo_evidence_operation_id\'];\n'
            '  final operationId =\n'
            '      storedOperationId is String && storedOperationId.trim().isNotEmpty\n'
            '      ? storedOperationId\n'
            '      : controller == null\n'
            '      ? null\n'
            '      : createOperationId();\n'
            '  final photoEvidenceOperationId =\n'
            '      storedPhotoOperationId is String &&\n'
            '          storedPhotoOperationId.trim().isNotEmpty\n'
            '      ? storedPhotoOperationId\n'
            '      : controller == null\n'
            '      ? null\n'
            '      : createOperationId();\n'
            '  final store = runtime?.composerDraftStore;\n'
            '  final scopeKey = runtime?.composerDraftScopeKey;\n'
            '  final persistence =\n'
            '      store != null &&\n'
            '          scopeKey != null &&\n'
            '          operationId != null &&\n'
            '          photoEvidenceOperationId != null\n'
            '      ? V2ProgressPersistence(\n'
            '          store: store,\n'
            '          scopeKey: scopeKey,\n'
            '          studentId: student.id,\n'
            '          subject: item.subject,\n'
            '          caseId: item.id,\n'
            '          operationId: operationId,\n'
            '          photoEvidenceOperationId: photoEvidenceOperationId,\n'
            '          initialDraft: initialDraft,\n'
            '        )\n'
            '      : null;\n'
            '  final storedCompletesCurrentAction =\n'
            '      initialDraft?.state[\'complete_current_action\'] == true;\n'
            '  final treatingCurrentAction =\n'
            '      completeCurrentActionInitially || storedCompletesCurrentAction;\n'
            '  final continuingExisting = transferredObservation != null;\n'
            '  final saved = await showV2ProgressComposer(\n'
            '    context,\n'
            '    studentName: student.name,\n'
            '    subject: item.subject,\n'
            '    caseTitle: item.title,\n'
            '    canCompleteCurrentAction:\n'
            '        controller?.hasPendingPrimaryAction(item.id) ?? false,\n'
            '    completeCurrentActionInitially: treatingCurrentAction,\n'
            '    businessDate: controller?.businessDate,\n'
            '    initialKind: continuingExisting\n'
            '        ? V2ProgressKind.observation\n'
            '        : item.pendingVerification\n'
            '        ? V2ProgressKind.assessment\n'
            '        : V2ProgressKind.observation,\n'
            '    composerTitle: continuingExisting\n'
            '        ? \'记到已有问题\'\n'
            '        : treatingCurrentAction\n'
            '        ? (item.pendingVerification ? \'处理复检提醒\' : \'处理提醒\')\n'
            '        : (item.pendingVerification ? \'记录复检\' : \'记录进展\'),\n'
            '    primaryLabel: continuingExisting\n'
            '        ? \'保存到原问题\'\n'
            '        : treatingCurrentAction\n'
            '        ? (item.pendingVerification ? \'保存复检处理\' : \'保存处理\')\n'
            '        : (item.pendingVerification ? \'保存复检\' : \'保存进展\'),\n'
            '    initialBody: transferredObservation?.body ?? \'\',\n'
            '    initialAttachments: transferredObservation?.attachments ?? const [],\n'
            '    persistence: persistence,\n'
            '    onSave: controller == null\n'
            '        ? null\n'
            '        : (draft) async {\n'
            '            await controller.recordProgress(\n'
            '              V2ProgressWrite(\n'
            '                operationId: operationId!,\n'
            '                photoEvidenceOperationId: photoEvidenceOperationId!,\n'
            '                caseId: item.id,\n'
            '                progressKind: _domainProgressKind(draft.kind),\n'
            '                summary: draft.body,\n'
            '                assessmentResult: draft.kind == V2ProgressKind.assessment\n'
            '                    ? _domainAssessmentResult(draft.assessmentResult)\n'
            '                    : null,\n'
            '                completeCurrentAction: draft.completeCurrentAction,\n'
            '                nextStep: _domainNextStep(draft.nextStep),\n'
            '                nextActionTitle: draft.nextStep == V2NextStep.remind\n'
            '                    ? draft.reminderTitle\n'
            '                    : null,\n'
            '                nextActionDueOn: draft.nextStep == V2NextStep.remind\n'
            '                    ? draft.reminderDate\n'
            '                    : null,\n'
            '                closeReason: draft.nextStep == V2NextStep.close\n'
            '                    ? _domainCloseReason(draft.closeReason)\n'
            '                    : null,\n'
            '                attachments: draft.attachments,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          },\n'
            '  );\n'
            '  if (saved && context.mounted) {\n'
            '    runtime?.onWorkspaceChanged?.call();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'CaseProgressKind _domainProgressKind(V2ProgressKind kind) => switch (kind) {\n'
            '  V2ProgressKind.observation => CaseProgressKind.observation,\n'
            '  V2ProgressKind.intervention => CaseProgressKind.intervention,\n'
            '  V2ProgressKind.assessment => CaseProgressKind.assessment,\n'
            '};\n'
            '\n'
            'CaseAssessmentResult? _domainAssessmentResult(V2AssessmentResult? result) =>\n'
            '    switch (result) {\n'
            '      null => null,\n'
            '      V2AssessmentResult.passed => CaseAssessmentResult.passed,\n'
            '      V2AssessmentResult.partial => CaseAssessmentResult.partial,\n'
            '      V2AssessmentResult.notPassed => CaseAssessmentResult.notPassed,\n'
            '    };\n'
            '\n'
            'CaseProgressNextStep _domainNextStep(V2NextStep step) => switch (step) {\n'
            '  V2NextStep.continueTracking => CaseProgressNextStep.continueTracking,\n'
            '  V2NextStep.remind => CaseProgressNextStep.remind,\n'
            '  V2NextStep.close => CaseProgressNextStep.close,\n'
            '};\n'
            '\n'
            'CaseClosureReason _domainCloseReason(V2CloseReason reason) => switch (reason) {\n'
            '  V2CloseReason.resolved => CaseClosureReason.resolved,\n'
            '  V2CloseReason.pauseTracking => CaseClosureReason.pauseTracking,\n'
            '  V2CloseReason.notIssue => CaseClosureReason.notIssue,\n'
            '  V2CloseReason.other => CaseClosureReason.other,\n'
            '};\n'
            '\n'
            'Future<void> _showV2ProgressCasePicker(\n'
            '  BuildContext context,\n'
            '  V2Student student,\n'
            ') async {\n'
            '  final items = V2WorkspaceDataScope.of(context).focusItemsForStudent(student);\n'
            '  if (items.isEmpty) {\n'
            '    return;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '  if (items.length == 1) {\n'
            '    await _showV2ProgressForCase(context, student, items.single);\n'
            '    return;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Widget choices(BuildContext sheetContext) => ListView.separated(\n'
            '    shrinkWrap: true,\n'
            '    itemCount: items.length,\n'
            '    separatorBuilder: (_, _) => Divider(\n'
            '      height: 1,\n'
            '      color: Theme.of(sheetContext).colorScheme.outlineVariant,\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '    itemBuilder: (_, index) {\n'
            '      final item = items[index];\n'
            '      return ListTile(\n'
            '        title: Text(item.title),\n'
            '        subtitle: Text(\n'
            '          \'${item.subject} · ${_caseStatusLabel(item)}\\n\'\n'
            '          \'下一步 ${_displayNextStep(item.nextStep)} · ${item.dueLabel}\',\n'
            '          maxLines: 2,\n'
            '          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        isThreeLine: true,\n'
            '        trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),\n'
            '        onTap: () => Navigator.of(sheetContext).pop(item),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    },\n'
            '  );\n'
            '\n'
            '  final compact = ResponsiveBreakpoints.isCompact(context);\n'
            '  final selected = compact\n'
            '      ? await showModalBottomSheet<V2FocusItem>(\n'
            '          context: context,\n'
            '          useSafeArea: true,\n'
            '          builder: (sheetContext) => Padding(\n'
            '            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 18, 18, 28),\n'
            '            child: Column(\n'
            '              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '              children: [\n'
            '                Text(\n'
            '                  \'选择要记录进展的问题\',\n'
            '                  style: Theme.of(sheetContext).textTheme.titleLarge,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '                choices(sheetContext),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        )\n'
            '      : await showDialog<V2FocusItem>(\n'
            '          context: context,\n'
            '          builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(\n'
            '            title: const Text(\'选择要记录进展的问题\'),\n'
            '            content: SizedBox(width: 420, child: choices(dialogContext)),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '  if (selected == null || !context.mounted) {\n'
            '    return;\n'
            '  }\n'
            '  await _showV2ProgressForCase(context, student, selected);\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class V2WorkspacePreview extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const V2WorkspacePreview({\n'
            '    super.key,\n'
            '    this.data = v2FixtureWorkspaceData,\n'
            '    this.workflowController,\n'
            '    this.composerDraftStore,\n'
            '    this.composerDraftScopeKey,\n'
            '    this.evidenceAttachmentRepository,\n'
            '    this.onExportStudent,\n'
            '    this.onExportMyStudents,\n'
            '    this.organizationPageBuilder,\n'
            '    this.managementPageBuilder,\n'
            '    this.updateService,\n'
            '    this.updateInstaller,\n'
            '    this.appVersion,\n'
            '    this.onSignOut,\n'
            '    this.onRefresh,\n'
            '    this.onWorkspaceChanged,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2WorkspaceData data;\n'
            '  final V2WorkflowController? workflowController;\n'
            '  final ComposerDraftStore? composerDraftStore;\n'
            '  final String? composerDraftScopeKey;\n'
            '  final EvidenceAttachmentRepository? evidenceAttachmentRepository;\n'
            '  final V2StudentExport? onExportStudent;\n'
            '  final V2WorkspaceExport? onExportMyStudents;\n'
            '  final V2OrganizationWorkspaceBuilder? organizationPageBuilder;\n'
            '  final WidgetBuilder? managementPageBuilder;\n'
            '  final UpdateService? updateService;\n'
            '  final UpdateInstaller? updateInstaller;\n'
            '  final String? appVersion;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onSignOut;\n'
            '  final V2WorkspaceRefresh? onRefresh;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onWorkspaceChanged;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<V2WorkspacePreview> createState() => _V2WorkspacePreviewState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _V2WorkspacePreviewState extends State<V2WorkspacePreview> {\n'
            '  V2WorkspaceDestination _destination = V2WorkspaceDestination.today;\n'
            '  V2WorkspaceDestination _lastPersonalDestination =\n'
            '      V2WorkspaceDestination.today;\n'
            '  V2OrganizationSection _organizationSection = V2OrganizationSection.learning;\n'
            '  V2Student? _selectedStudent;\n'
            '  V2FocusItem? _selectedCase;\n'
            '  bool _showCase = false;\n'
            '  bool _showStudentDetail = false;\n'
            '  bool _checkingForUpdates = false;\n'
            '  bool _refreshing = false;\n'
            '  bool _composerDraftRecoveryScheduled = false;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    _reconcileSelection();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didUpdateWidget(covariant V2WorkspacePreview oldWidget) {\n'
            '    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);\n'
            '    if (!identical(oldWidget.data, widget.data)) {\n'
            '      _reconcileSelection();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (widget.organizationPageBuilder == null &&\n'
            '        _destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.organization) {\n'
            '      _destination = V2WorkspaceDestination.today;\n'
            '      _lastPersonalDestination = V2WorkspaceDestination.today;\n'
            '      _showCase = false;\n'
            '      _showStudentDetail = false;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (oldWidget.composerDraftScopeKey != widget.composerDraftScopeKey ||\n'
            '        oldWidget.composerDraftStore != widget.composerDraftStore) {\n'
            '      _composerDraftRecoveryScheduled = false;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _scheduleComposerDraftRecovery(BuildContext scopedContext) {\n'
            '    if (_composerDraftRecoveryScheduled ||\n'
            '        widget.composerDraftStore == null ||\n'
            '        widget.composerDraftScopeKey == null) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    _composerDraftRecoveryScheduled = true;\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\n'
            '      if (mounted && scopedContext.mounted) {\n'
            '        unawaited(_restoreComposerDraft(scopedContext));\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _clearComposerDraft() async {\n'
            '    final store = widget.composerDraftStore;\n'
            '    final scopeKey = widget.composerDraftScopeKey;\n'
            '    if (store == null || scopeKey == null) return;\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await store.clear(scopeKey);\n'
            '    } catch (_) {}\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _restoreComposerDraft(BuildContext scopedContext) async {\n'
            '    final store = widget.composerDraftStore;\n'
            '    final scopeKey = widget.composerDraftScopeKey;\n'
            '    if (store == null || scopeKey == null) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    ComposerDraftSnapshot? draft;\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      draft = await store.load(scopeKey);\n'
            '    } catch (_) {\n'
            '      await _clearComposerDraft();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (!mounted || !scopedContext.mounted || draft == null) return;\n'
            '\n'
            '    V2Student? student;\n'
            '    for (final candidate in widget.data.students) {\n'
            '      if (candidate.id == draft.studentId) {\n'
            '        student = candidate;\n'
            '        break;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    if (student == null) {\n'
            '      await _clearComposerDraft();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    final operationId = draft.state[\'operation_id\'];\n'
            '    if (operationId is! String || operationId.trim().isEmpty) {\n'
            '      await _clearComposerDraft();\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (draft.kind == \'quick_capture\') {\n'
            '      final subject = draft.subject;\n'
            '      if (subject != null && !student.subjects.contains(subject)) {\n'
            '        await _clearComposerDraft();\n'
            '        return;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (!mounted || !scopedContext.mounted) return;\n'
            '      await _showV2QuickCaptureForStudent(\n'
            '        scopedContext,\n'
            '        student,\n'
            '        initialDraft: draft,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (draft.kind == \'progress\') {\n'
            '      final subject = draft.subject;\n'
            '      final caseId = draft.caseId;\n'
            '      final photoOperationId = draft.state[\'photo_evidence_operation_id\'];\n'
            '      if (subject == null ||\n'
            '          !student.subjects.contains(subject) ||\n'
            '          caseId == null ||\n'
            '          photoOperationId is! String ||\n'
            '          photoOperationId.trim().isEmpty) {\n'
            '        await _clearComposerDraft();\n'
            '        return;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      V2FocusItem? item;\n'
            '      for (final candidate in widget.data.focusItems) {\n'
            '        if (candidate.id == caseId &&\n'
            '            candidate.studentId == student.id &&\n'
            '            candidate.subject == subject &&\n'
            '            !candidate.closed) {\n'
            '          item = candidate;\n'
            '          break;\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (item == null) {\n'
            '        await _clearComposerDraft();\n'
            '        return;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      _openCase(item);\n'
            '      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);\n'
            '      if (!mounted || !scopedContext.mounted) return;\n'
            '      await _showV2ProgressForCase(\n'
            '        scopedContext,\n'
            '        student,\n'
            '        item,\n'
            '        initialDraft: draft,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    await _clearComposerDraft();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _reconcileSelection() {\n'
            '    final students = widget.data.students;\n'
            '    if (students.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      _selectedStudent = null;\n'
            '      _selectedCase = null;\n'
            '      _showCase = false;\n'
            '      _showStudentDetail = false;\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    final currentStudentId = _selectedStudent?.id;\n'
            '    _selectedStudent = students.firstWhere(\n'
            '      (student) => student.id == currentStudentId,\n'
            '      orElse: () => students.first,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '\n'
            '    final currentCaseId = _selectedCase?.id;\n'
            '    if (currentCaseId == null) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final matchingCases = widget.data.focusItems\n'
            '        .where((item) => item.id == currentCaseId)\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\n'
            '    if (matchingCases.isEmpty ||\n'
            '        matchingCases.first.studentId != _selectedStudent!.id) {\n'
            '      _selectedCase = null;\n'
            '      _showCase = false;\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      _selectedCase = matchingCases.first;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _openStudent(V2Student student) {\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _selectedStudent = student;\n'
            '      _selectedCase = null;\n'
            '      _showCase = false;\n'
            '      _showStudentDetail = true;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _openCase(V2FocusItem item) {\n'
            '    final student = widget.data.studentForFocusItemOrNull(item);\n'
            '    if (student == null) {\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      _destination = V2WorkspaceDestination.students;\n'
            '      _selectedStudent = student;\n'
            '      _selectedCase = item;\n'
            '      _showCase = true;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _closeCase() => setState(() => _showCase = false);\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _closeStudentDetail() => setState(() => _showStudentDetail = false);\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _changeDestination(V2WorkspaceDestination value) {\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      if (value == V2WorkspaceDestination.organization) {\n'
            '        if (_destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.organization) {\n'
            '          _lastPersonalDestination = _destination;\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        _destination = value;\n'
            '        return;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '\n'
            '      _lastPersonalDestination = value;\n'
            '      _destination = value;\n'
            '      _showCase = false;\n'
            '      if (value != V2WorkspaceDestination.students) {\n'
            '        _showStudentDetail = false;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _returnFromOrganization() {\n'
            '    setState(() => _destination = _lastPersonalDestination);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _openOrganization(V2OrganizationSection section) {\n'
            '    setState(() {\n'
            '      if (_destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.organization) {\n'
            '        _lastPersonalDestination = _destination;\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      _organizationSection = section;\n'
            '      _destination = V2WorkspaceDestination.organization;\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _changeOrganizationSection(V2OrganizationSection section) {\n'
            '    if (_organizationSection == section) return;\n'
            '    setState(() => _organizationSection = section);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _openManagement(BuildContext context) async {\n'
            '    final builder = widget.managementPageBuilder;\n'
            '    if (builder == null) return;\n'
            '    await Navigator.of(context)\n'
            '        .push<void>(MaterialPageRoute<void>(builder: builder));\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _checkForUpdates(BuildContext context) async {\n'
            '    final service = widget.updateService;\n'
            '    final installer = widget.updateInstaller;\n'
            '    if (service == null || installer == null || _checkingForUpdates) return;\n'
            '    setState(() => _checkingForUpdates = true);\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await runV2UpdateFlow(context, service: service, installer: installer);\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _checkingForUpdates = false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _refreshWorkspace() async {\n'
            '    final refresh = widget.onRefresh;\n'
            '    if (refresh == null || _refreshing) return;\n'
            '    setState(() => _refreshing = true);\n'
            '    try {\n'
            '      await refresh();\n'
            '    } finally {\n'
            '      if (mounted) setState(() => _refreshing = false);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _afterMenuClose(BuildContext menuContext, VoidCallback action) {\n'
            '    Navigator.of(menuContext).pop();\n'
            '    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {\n'
            '      if (mounted) action();\n'
            '    });\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _showOperationGuide(BuildContext context) async {\n'
            '    if (ResponsiveBreakpoints.isCompact(context)) {\n'
            '      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(\n'
            '        context: context,\n'
            '        useSafeArea: true,\n'
            '        showDragHandle: true,\n'
            '        isScrollControlled: true,\n'
            '        builder: (sheetContext) => const FractionallySizedBox(\n'
            '          heightFactor: 0.82,\n'
            '          child: Padding(\n'
            '            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 4, 20, 24),\n'
            '            child: _V2OperationGuide(showTitle: true),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      return;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    await showDialog<void>(\n'
            '      context: context,\n'
            '      builder: (dialogContext) => const AlertDialog(\n'
            '        title: Text(\'操作指南\'),\n'
            '        content: SizedBox(width: 520, height: 500, child: _V2OperationGuide()),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<void> _showWorkspaceMenu(BuildContext context) async {\n'
            '    Widget menu(BuildContext menuContext) => SafeArea(\n'
            '      child: Padding(\n'
            '        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 12, 12, 18),\n'
            '        child: Column(\n'
            '          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,\n'
            '          children: [\n'
            '            if (widget.organizationPageBuilder != null)\n'
            '              ListTile(\n'
            '                key: const Key(\'v2-menu-open-organization\'),\n'
            '                leading: const Icon(Icons.apartment_outlined),\n'
            '                title: const Text(\'进入机构工作区\'),\n'
            '                subtitle: const Text(\'查看机构学情监督与管理\'),\n'
            '                onTap: () => _afterMenuClose(\n'
            '                  menuContext,\n'
            '                  () => _openOrganization(V2OrganizationSection.learning),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            if (widget.onRefresh != null)\n'
            '              ListTile(\n'
            '                key: const Key(\'v2-menu-refresh\'),\n'
            '                leading: _refreshing\n'
            '                    ? const SizedBox(\n'
            '                        width: 22,\n'
            '                        height: 22,\n'
            '                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),\n'
            '                      )\n'
            '                    : const Icon(Icons.refresh_outlined),\n'
            '                title: Text(_refreshing ? \'正在刷新\' : \'刷新学情\'),\n'
            '                subtitle: const Text(\'重新读取最新学生与学情记录\'),\n'
            '                onTap: _refreshing\n'
            '                    ? null\n'
            '                    : () => _afterMenuClose(\n'
            '                        menuContext,\n'
            '                        () => _refreshWorkspace(),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ListTile(\n'
            '              key: const Key(\'v2-menu-operation-guide\'),\n'
            '              leading: const Icon(Icons.help_outline),\n'
            '              title: const Text(\'操作指南\'),\n'
            '              subtitle: const Text(\'常用操作一页看懂\'),\n'
            '              onTap: () => _afterMenuClose(\n'
            '                menuContext,\n'
            '                () => _showOperationGuide(context),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            if (widget.onExportMyStudents != null)\n'
            '              ListTile(\n'
            '                key: const Key(\'v2-menu-export-my-students\'),\n'
            '                leading: const Icon(Icons.download_outlined),\n'
            '                title: const Text(\'导出我的学生学情\'),\n'
            '                subtitle: const Text(\'导出当前有权限的学生、记录与图片\'),\n'
            '                onTap: () => _afterMenuClose(\n'
            '                  menuContext,\n'
            '                  () => unawaited(widget.onExportMyStudents!(context)),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            if (widget.organizationPageBuilder == null &&\n'
            '                widget.managementPageBuilder != null)\n'
            '              ListTile(\n'
            '                leading: const Icon(Icons.admin_panel_settings_outlined),\n'
            '                title: const Text(\'机构管理\'),\n'
            '                subtitle: const Text(\'成员、学生、学科与记录导出\'),\n'
            '                onTap: () => _afterMenuClose(\n'
            '                  menuContext,\n'
            '                  () => _openManagement(context),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ListTile(\n'
            '              leading: _checkingForUpdates\n'
            '                  ? const SizedBox(\n'
            '                      width: 24,\n'
            '                      height: 24,\n'
            '                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),\n'
            '                    )\n'
            '                  : const Icon(Icons.system_update_alt_outlined),\n'
            '              title: const Text(\'检查更新\'),\n'
            '              subtitle: widget.appVersion == null\n'
            '                  ? null\n'
            '                  : Text(\'当前版本 ${widget.appVersion}\'),\n'
            '              onTap:\n'
            '                  _checkingForUpdates ||\n'
            '                      widget.updateService == null ||\n'
            '                      widget.updateInstaller == null\n'
            '                  ? null\n'
            '                  : () => _afterMenuClose(\n'
            '                      menuContext,\n'
            '                      () => _checkForUpdates(context),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            if (widget.onSignOut != null)\n'
            '              ListTile(\n'
            '                leading: const Icon(Icons.logout_outlined),\n'
            '                title: const Text(\'退出登录\'),\n'
            '                onTap: () => _afterMenuClose(menuContext, widget.onSignOut!),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (ResponsiveBreakpoints.isCompact(context)) {\n'
            '      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(\n'
            '        context: context,\n'
            '        useSafeArea: true,\n'
            '        showDragHandle: true,\n'
            '        builder: menu,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      await showDialog<void>(\n'
            '        context: context,\n'
            '        builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(\n'
            '          title: const Text(\'更多\'),\n'
            '          content: SizedBox(width: 390, child: menu(dialogContext)),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    return _V2RuntimeScope(\n'
            '      workflowController: widget.workflowController,\n'
            '      evidenceAttachmentRepository: widget.evidenceAttachmentRepository,\n'
            '      composerDraftStore: widget.composerDraftStore,\n'
            '      composerDraftScopeKey: widget.composerDraftScopeKey,\n'
            '      studentExport: widget.onExportStudent,\n'
            '      onWorkspaceChanged: widget.onWorkspaceChanged,\n'
            '      child: V2WorkspaceDataScope(\n'
            '        data: widget.data,\n'
            '        child: Builder(\n'
            '          builder: (context) {\n'
            '            _scheduleComposerDraftRecovery(context);\n'
            '            if (widget.data.students.isEmpty) {\n'
            '              return _EmptyWorkspacePreview(\n'
            '                onOpenManagement: widget.managementPageBuilder == null\n'
            '                    ? null\n'
            '                    : () => _openManagement(context),\n'
            '                onOpenMore: () => _showWorkspaceMenu(context),\n'
            '              );\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            final selectedStudent =\n'
            '                _selectedStudent ?? widget.data.students.first;\n'
            '            return LayoutBuilder(\n'
            '              builder: (context, constraints) {\n'
            '                final sizeClass = ResponsiveBreakpoints.classify(\n'
            '                  constraints.maxWidth,\n'
            '                );\n'
            '                if (sizeClass == WindowSizeClass.compact) {\n'
            '                  return _CompactWorkspace(\n'
            '                    destination: _destination,\n'
            '                    selectedStudent: selectedStudent,\n'
            '                    selectedCase: _selectedCase,\n'
            '                    showCase: _showCase,\n'
            '                    showStudentDetail: _showStudentDetail,\n'
            '                    onDestinationChanged: _changeDestination,\n'
            '                    onStudentSelected: _openStudent,\n'
            '                    onBackFromStudent: _closeStudentDetail,\n'
            '                    onOpenCase: _openCase,\n'
            '                    onBackFromCase: _closeCase,\n'
            '                    organizationPageBuilder: widget.organizationPageBuilder,\n'
            '                    organizationSection: _organizationSection,\n'
            '                    onOrganizationSelected: _openOrganization,\n'
            '                    onOrganizationSectionChanged: _changeOrganizationSection,\n'
            '                    onBackFromOrganization: _returnFromOrganization,\n'
            '                    onOpenMore: () => _showWorkspaceMenu(context),\n'
            '                  );\n'
            '                }\n'
            '                if (sizeClass == WindowSizeClass.medium) {\n'
            '                  return _MediumWorkspace(\n'
            '                    destination: _destination,\n'
            '                    selectedStudent: selectedStudent,\n'
            '                    selectedCase: _selectedCase,\n'
            '                    showCase: _showCase,\n'
            '                    showStudentDetail: _showStudentDetail,\n'
            '                    onDestinationChanged: _changeDestination,\n'
            '                    onStudentSelected: _openStudent,\n'
            '                    onBackFromStudent: _closeStudentDetail,\n'
            '                    onOpenCase: _openCase,\n'
            '                    onBackFromCase: _closeCase,\n'
            '                    organizationPageBuilder: widget.organizationPageBuilder,\n'
            '                    organizationSection: _organizationSection,\n'
            '                    onOrganizationSelected: _openOrganization,\n'
            '                    onOrganizationSectionChanged: _changeOrganizationSection,\n'
            '                    onBackFromOrganization: _returnFromOrganization,\n'
            '                    onRefresh: widget.onRefresh == null\n'
            '                        ? null\n'
            '                        : () => _refreshWorkspace(),\n'
            '                    refreshing: _refreshing,\n'
            '                    onManage:\n'
            '                        widget.organizationPageBuilder != null ||\n'
            '                            widget.managementPageBuilder == null\n'
            '                        ? null\n'
            '                        : () => _openManagement(context),\n'
            '                    onSettings: () => _showWorkspaceMenu(context),\n'
            '                  );\n'
            '                }\n'
            '                return _DesktopWorkspace(\n'
            '                  destination: _destination,\n'
            '                  selectedStudent: selectedStudent,\n'
            '                  selectedCase: _selectedCase,\n'
            '                  showCase: _showCase,\n'
            '                  onDestinationChanged: _changeDestination,\n'
            '                  onStudentSelected: _openStudent,\n'
            '                  onOpenCase: _openCase,\n'
            '                  onBackFromCase: _closeCase,\n'
            '                  organizationPageBuilder: widget.organizationPageBuilder,\n'
            '                  organizationSection: _organizationSection,\n'
            '                  onOrganizationSelected: _openOrganization,\n'
            '                  onOrganizationSectionChanged: _changeOrganizationSection,\n'
            '                  onBackFromOrganization: _returnFromOrganization,\n'
            '                  onRefresh: widget.onRefresh == null\n'
            '                      ? null\n'
            '                      : () => _refreshWorkspace(),\n'
            '                  refreshing: _refreshing,\n'
            '                  onManage:\n'
            '                      widget.organizationPageBuilder != null ||\n'
            '                          widget.managementPageBuilder == null\n'
            '                      ? null\n'
            '                      : () => _openManagement(context),\n'
            '                  onSettings: () => _showWorkspaceMenu(context),\n'
            '                );\n'
            '              },\n'
            '            );\n'
            '          },\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _QuietPaneTransition extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _QuietPaneTransition({\n'
            '    required this.transitionKey,\n'
            '    required this.child,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final Object transitionKey;\n'
            '  final Widget child;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final enterDuration = AppMotion.effectiveDuration(\n'
            '      context,\n'
            '      AppMotion.standard,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final exitDuration = AppMotion.effectiveDuration(context, AppMotion.quick);\n'
            '    return AnimatedSwitcher(\n'
            '      duration: enterDuration,\n'
            '      reverseDuration: exitDuration,\n'
            '      switchInCurve: AppMotion.enter,\n'
            '      switchOutCurve: AppMotion.exit,\n'
            '      transitionBuilder: (child, animation) {\n'
            '        final curved = CurvedAnimation(\n'
            '          parent: animation,\n'
            '          curve: AppMotion.enter,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '        return FadeTransition(\n'
            '          opacity: curved,\n'
            '          child: SlideTransition(\n'
            '            position: Tween<Offset>(\n'
            '              begin: const Offset(0, 0.012),\n'
            '              end: Offset.zero,\n'
            '            ).animate(curved),\n'
            '            child: child,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      },\n'
            '      child: KeyedSubtree(key: ValueKey<Object>(transitionKey), child: child),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _DesktopWorkspace extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _DesktopWorkspace({\n'
            '    required this.destination,\n'
            '    required this.selectedStudent,\n'
            '    required this.selectedCase,\n'
            '    required this.showCase,\n'
            '    required this.onDestinationChanged,\n'
            '    required this.onStudentSelected,\n'
            '    required this.onOpenCase,\n'
            '    required this.onBackFromCase,\n'
            '    required this.organizationPageBuilder,\n'
            '    required this.organizationSection,\n'
            '    required this.onOrganizationSelected,\n'
            '    required this.onOrganizationSectionChanged,\n'
            '    required this.onBackFromOrganization,\n'
            '    required this.onSettings,\n'
            '    required this.refreshing,\n'
            '    this.onRefresh,\n'
            '    this.onManage,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2WorkspaceDestination destination;\n'
            '  final V2Student selectedStudent;\n'
            '  final V2FocusItem? selectedCase;\n'
            '  final bool showCase;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2WorkspaceDestination> onDestinationChanged;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2Student> onStudentSelected;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2FocusItem> onOpenCase;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onBackFromCase;\n'
            '  final V2OrganizationWorkspaceBuilder? organizationPageBuilder;\n'
            '  final V2OrganizationSection organizationSection;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2OrganizationSection> onOrganizationSelected;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2OrganizationSection> onOrganizationSectionChanged;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onBackFromOrganization;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onRefresh;\n'
            '  final bool refreshing;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onManage;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onSettings;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final border = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outlineVariant;\n'
            '    final width = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width;\n'
            '    final expandedRail = width >= 1280;\n'
            '    final studentPaneWidth = expandedRail ? 320.0 : 288.0;\n'
            '    return Scaffold(\n'
            '      key: const Key(\'v2-expanded-shell\'),\n'
            '      body: SafeArea(\n'
            '        child: Row(\n'
            '          children: [\n'
            '            SizedBox(\n'
            '              width: expandedRail ? 132 : 72,\n'
            '              child: _NavigationRail(\n'
            '                selectedDestination: destination,\n'
            '                expanded: expandedRail,\n'
            '                onSelected: onDestinationChanged,\n'
            '                showOrganization: organizationPageBuilder != null,\n'
            '                organizationSection: organizationSection,\n'
            '                onOrganizationSelected: onOrganizationSelected,\n'
            '                onRefresh: destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.organization\n'
            '                    ? null\n'
            '                    : onRefresh,\n'
            '                refreshing: refreshing,\n'
            '                onManage: onManage,\n'
            '                onSettings: onSettings,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            VerticalDivider(width: 1, color: border),\n'
            '            if (destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students) ...[\n'
            '              SizedBox(\n'
            '                width: studentPaneWidth,\n'
            '                child: _StudentListPane(\n'
            '                  selectedStudent: selectedStudent,\n'
            '                  onSelected: onStudentSelected,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              VerticalDivider(width: 1, color: border),\n'
            '              Expanded(\n'
            '                child: _QuietPaneTransition(\n'
            '                  transitionKey: showCase && selectedCase != null\n'
            '                      ? \'case-${selectedCase!.id}\'\n'
            '                      : \'student-${selectedStudent.id}\',\n'
            '                  child: showCase && selectedCase != null\n'
            '                      ? _CaseDetailPane(\n'
            '                          student: selectedStudent,\n'
            '                          item: selectedCase!,\n'
            '                          onBack: onBackFromCase,\n'
            '                        )\n'
            '                      : _StudentDetailPane(\n'
            '                          student: selectedStudent,\n'
            '                          onOpenCase: onOpenCase,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ] else if (destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.today) ...[\n'
            '              Expanded(\n'
            '                child: _TodayPane(\n'
            '                  onOpenCase: onOpenCase,\n'
            '                  onOpenStudent: (student) {\n'
            '                    onStudentSelected(student);\n'
            '                    onDestinationChanged(V2WorkspaceDestination.students);\n'
            '                  },\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ] else if (destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.learning) ...[\n'
            '              Expanded(child: _CaseIndexPane(onOpenCase: onOpenCase)),\n'
            '            ] else ...[\n'
            '              Expanded(\n'
            '                child: organizationPageBuilder!(\n'
            '                  context,\n'
            '                  onBackFromOrganization,\n'
            '                  organizationSection,\n'
            '                  onOrganizationSectionChanged,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MediumWorkspace extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _MediumWorkspace({\n'
            '    required this.destination,\n'
            '    required this.selectedStudent,\n'
            '    required this.selectedCase,\n'
            '    required this.showCase,\n'
            '    required this.showStudentDetail,\n'
            '    required this.onDestinationChanged,\n'
            '    required this.onStudentSelected,\n'
            '    required this.onBackFromStudent,\n'
            '    required this.onOpenCase,\n'
            '    required this.onBackFromCase,\n'
            '    required this.organizationPageBuilder,\n'
            '    required this.organizationSection,\n'
            '    required this.onOrganizationSelected,\n'
            '    required this.onOrganizationSectionChanged,\n'
            '    required this.onBackFromOrganization,\n'
            '    required this.onSettings,\n'
            '    required this.refreshing,\n'
            '    this.onRefresh,\n'
            '    this.onManage,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2WorkspaceDestination destination;\n'
            '  final V2Student selectedStudent;\n'
            '  final V2FocusItem? selectedCase;\n'
            '  final bool showCase;\n'
            '  final bool showStudentDetail;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2WorkspaceDestination> onDestinationChanged;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2Student> onStudentSelected;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onBackFromStudent;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2FocusItem> onOpenCase;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onBackFromCase;\n'
            '  final V2OrganizationWorkspaceBuilder? organizationPageBuilder;\n'
            '  final V2OrganizationSection organizationSection;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2OrganizationSection> onOrganizationSelected;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2OrganizationSection> onOrganizationSectionChanged;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onBackFromOrganization;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onRefresh;\n'
            '  final bool refreshing;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onManage;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onSettings;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_MediumWorkspace> createState() => _MediumWorkspaceState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _MediumWorkspaceState extends State<_MediumWorkspace> {\n'
            '  void _changeDestination(V2WorkspaceDestination destination) {\n'
            '    if (destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '        widget.showStudentDetail) {\n'
            '      widget.onBackFromStudent();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    widget.onDestinationChanged(destination);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final border = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outlineVariant;\n'
            '    return LayoutBuilder(\n'
            '      builder: (context, constraints) {\n'
            '        // The rail is structural; the page itself adapts to the remaining pane.\n'
            '        // This keeps a 600px window from pretending its 527px content pane is\n'
            '        // a wide desktop surface while still avoiding mobile bottom navigation.\n'
            '        final paneWidth = (constraints.maxWidth - 73).clamp(\n'
            '          0.0,\n'
            '          double.infinity,\n'
            '        );\n'
            '        final paneCompact =\n'
            '            ResponsiveBreakpoints.classify(paneWidth.toDouble()) ==\n'
            '            WindowSizeClass.compact;\n'
            '\n'
            '        Widget body;\n'
            '        if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '            widget.showCase &&\n'
            '            widget.selectedCase != null) {\n'
            '          body = _CaseDetailPane(\n'
            '            student: widget.selectedStudent,\n'
            '            item: widget.selectedCase!,\n'
            '            onBack: widget.onBackFromCase,\n'
            '            compact: paneCompact,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        } else if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '            widget.showStudentDetail) {\n'
            '          body = _StudentDetailPane(\n'
            '            student: widget.selectedStudent,\n'
            '            onOpenCase: widget.onOpenCase,\n'
            '            compact: paneCompact,\n'
            '            onBack: widget.onBackFromStudent,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        } else if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students) {\n'
            '          body = _StudentListPane(\n'
            '            selectedStudent: widget.selectedStudent,\n'
            '            compact: true,\n'
            '            headerPadding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(\n'
            '              paneCompact ? AppSpacing.mdPlus : AppSpacing.xl,\n'
            '              paneCompact ? AppSpacing.mdPlus : AppSpacing.xl,\n'
            '              paneCompact ? AppSpacing.mdPlus : AppSpacing.xl,\n'
            '              12,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            onSelected: widget.onStudentSelected,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        } else if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.today) {\n'
            '          body = _TodayPane(\n'
            '            onOpenCase: widget.onOpenCase,\n'
            '            onOpenStudent: (student) {\n'
            '              widget.onStudentSelected(student);\n'
            '              widget.onDestinationChanged(V2WorkspaceDestination.students);\n'
            '            },\n'
            '            compact: paneCompact,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        } else if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.learning) {\n'
            '          body = _CaseIndexPane(\n'
            '            onOpenCase: widget.onOpenCase,\n'
            '            compact: paneCompact,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        } else {\n'
            '          body = widget.organizationPageBuilder!(\n'
            '            context,\n'
            '            widget.onBackFromOrganization,\n'
            '            widget.organizationSection,\n'
            '            widget.onOrganizationSectionChanged,\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        }\n'
            '\n'
            '        final hasInternalHistory =\n'
            '            widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '            (widget.showCase || widget.showStudentDetail);\n'
            '        final handlesSystemBack =\n'
            '            hasInternalHistory ||\n'
            '            (widget.destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.today &&\n'
            '                widget.destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.organization);\n'
            '\n'
            '        return PopScope<void>(\n'
            '          canPop: !handlesSystemBack,\n'
            '          onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, _) {\n'
            '            if (didPop) return;\n'
            '            if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '                widget.showCase) {\n'
            '              widget.onBackFromCase();\n'
            '              return;\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '                widget.showStudentDetail) {\n'
            '              widget.onBackFromStudent();\n'
            '              return;\n'
            '            }\n'
            '            if (widget.destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.today &&\n'
            '                widget.destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.organization) {\n'
            '              widget.onDestinationChanged(V2WorkspaceDestination.today);\n'
            '            }\n'
            '          },\n'
            '          child: Scaffold(\n'
            '            key: const Key(\'v2-medium-shell\'),\n'
            '            backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,\n'
            '            body: SafeArea(\n'
            '              child: Row(\n'
            '                children: [\n'
            '                  SizedBox(\n'
            '                    width: 72,\n'
            '                    child: _NavigationRail(\n'
            '                      selectedDestination: widget.destination,\n'
            '                      onSelected: _changeDestination,\n'
            '                      showOrganization: widget.organizationPageBuilder != null,\n'
            '                      organizationSection: widget.organizationSection,\n'
            '                      onOrganizationSelected: widget.onOrganizationSelected,\n'
            '                      onRefresh:\n'
            '                          widget.destination ==\n'
            '                              V2WorkspaceDestination.organization\n'
            '                          ? null\n'
            '                          : widget.onRefresh,\n'
            '                      refreshing: widget.refreshing,\n'
            '                      onManage: widget.onManage,\n'
            '                      onSettings: widget.onSettings,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  VerticalDivider(width: 1, color: border),\n'
            '                  Expanded(child: body),\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      },\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _CompactWorkspace extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _CompactWorkspace({\n'
            '    required this.destination,\n'
            '    required this.selectedStudent,\n'
            '    required this.selectedCase,\n'
            '    required this.showCase,\n'
            '    required this.showStudentDetail,\n'
            '    required this.onDestinationChanged,\n'
            '    required this.onStudentSelected,\n'
            '    required this.onBackFromStudent,\n'
            '    required this.onOpenCase,\n'
            '    required this.onBackFromCase,\n'
            '    required this.organizationPageBuilder,\n'
            '    required this.organizationSection,\n'
            '    required this.onOrganizationSelected,\n'
            '    required this.onOrganizationSectionChanged,\n'
            '    required this.onBackFromOrganization,\n'
            '    required this.onOpenMore,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2WorkspaceDestination destination;\n'
            '  final V2Student selectedStudent;\n'
            '  final V2FocusItem? selectedCase;\n'
            '  final bool showCase;\n'
            '  final bool showStudentDetail;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2WorkspaceDestination> onDestinationChanged;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2Student> onStudentSelected;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onBackFromStudent;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2FocusItem> onOpenCase;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onBackFromCase;\n'
            '  final V2OrganizationWorkspaceBuilder? organizationPageBuilder;\n'
            '  final V2OrganizationSection organizationSection;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2OrganizationSection> onOrganizationSelected;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2OrganizationSection> onOrganizationSectionChanged;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onBackFromOrganization;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onOpenMore;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_CompactWorkspace> createState() => _CompactWorkspaceState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _CompactWorkspaceState extends State<_CompactWorkspace> {\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    Widget body;\n'
            '    if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '        widget.showCase &&\n'
            '        widget.selectedCase != null) {\n'
            '      body = _CaseDetailPane(\n'
            '        student: widget.selectedStudent,\n'
            '        item: widget.selectedCase!,\n'
            '        onBack: widget.onBackFromCase,\n'
            '        compact: true,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } else if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '        widget.showStudentDetail) {\n'
            '      body = _StudentDetailPane(\n'
            '        student: widget.selectedStudent,\n'
            '        onOpenCase: widget.onOpenCase,\n'
            '        compact: true,\n'
            '        onBack: widget.onBackFromStudent,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } else if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students) {\n'
            '      body = _StudentListPane(\n'
            '        selectedStudent: widget.selectedStudent,\n'
            '        compact: true,\n'
            '        onOpenMore: widget.onOpenMore,\n'
            '        onSelected: widget.onStudentSelected,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } else if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.today) {\n'
            '      body = _TodayPane(\n'
            '        onOpenCase: widget.onOpenCase,\n'
            '        onOpenStudent: (student) {\n'
            '          widget.onStudentSelected(student);\n'
            '          widget.onDestinationChanged(V2WorkspaceDestination.students);\n'
            '        },\n'
            '        compact: true,\n'
            '        onOpenMore: widget.onOpenMore,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } else if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.learning) {\n'
            '      body = _CaseIndexPane(\n'
            '        onOpenCase: widget.onOpenCase,\n'
            '        compact: true,\n'
            '        onOpenMore: widget.onOpenMore,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    } else {\n'
            '      body = widget.organizationPageBuilder!(\n'
            '        context,\n'
            '        widget.onBackFromOrganization,\n'
            '        widget.organizationSection,\n'
            '        widget.onOrganizationSectionChanged,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    const destinations = <V2WorkspaceDestination>[\n'
