            '      V2WorkspaceDestination.today,\n'
            '      V2WorkspaceDestination.students,\n'
            '      V2WorkspaceDestination.learning,\n'
            '    ];\n'
            '    final hasInternalHistory =\n'
            '        widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '        (widget.showCase || widget.showStudentDetail);\n'
            '    final handlesSystemBack =\n'
            '        hasInternalHistory ||\n'
            '        (widget.destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.today &&\n'
            '            widget.destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.organization);\n'
            '    return PopScope<void>(\n'
            '      canPop: !handlesSystemBack,\n'
            '      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, _) {\n'
            '        if (didPop) return;\n'
            '        if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '            widget.showCase) {\n'
            '          widget.onBackFromCase();\n'
            '          return;\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        if (widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.students &&\n'
            '            widget.showStudentDetail) {\n'
            '          widget.onBackFromStudent();\n'
            '          return;\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        if (widget.destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.today &&\n'
            '            widget.destination != V2WorkspaceDestination.organization) {\n'
            '          widget.onDestinationChanged(V2WorkspaceDestination.today);\n'
            '        }\n'
            '      },\n'
            '      child: Scaffold(\n'
            '        key: const Key(\'v2-compact-shell\'),\n'
            '        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,\n'
            '        body: SafeArea(child: body),\n'
            '        bottomNavigationBar:\n'
            '            hasInternalHistory ||\n'
            '                widget.destination == V2WorkspaceDestination.organization\n'
            '            ? null\n'
            '            : NavigationBar(\n'
            '                backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,\n'
            '                selectedIndex: destinations.indexOf(widget.destination),\n'
            '                onDestinationSelected: (index) {\n'
            '                  widget.onDestinationChanged(destinations[index]);\n'
            '                },\n'
            '                destinations: [\n'
            '                  for (final destination in destinations)\n'
            '                    _compactNavigationDestination(destination),\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _NavigationRail extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _NavigationRail({\n'
            '    required this.selectedDestination,\n'
            '    required this.onSelected,\n'
            '    required this.onSettings,\n'
            '    required this.refreshing,\n'
            '    required this.showOrganization,\n'
            '    required this.organizationSection,\n'
            '    required this.onOrganizationSelected,\n'
            '    this.expanded = false,\n'
            '    this.onRefresh,\n'
            '    this.onManage,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2WorkspaceDestination selectedDestination;\n'
            '  final bool expanded;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2WorkspaceDestination> onSelected;\n'
            '  final bool showOrganization;\n'
            '  final V2OrganizationSection organizationSection;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2OrganizationSection> onOrganizationSelected;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onRefresh;\n'
            '  final bool refreshing;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onManage;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onSettings;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    return ColoredBox(\n'
            '      color: scheme.surfaceContainerLowest,\n'
            '      child: Column(\n'
            '        children: [\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 18),\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            \'学情\',\n'
            '            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelMedium?.copyWith(\n'
            '              color: scheme.primary,\n'
            '              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,\n'
            '              letterSpacing: 0.6,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '          if (showOrganization && expanded) const _RailGroupLabel(\'我的教学\'),\n'
            '          for (final destination in const <V2WorkspaceDestination>[\n'
            '            V2WorkspaceDestination.today,\n'
            '            V2WorkspaceDestination.students,\n'
            '            V2WorkspaceDestination.learning,\n'
            '          ])\n'
            '            _RailItem(\n'
            '              icon: _destinationIcon(destination),\n'
            '              tooltip: _destinationLabel(destination),\n'
            '              selected: selectedDestination == destination,\n'
            '              onTap: () => onSelected(destination),\n'
            '              expanded: expanded,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          if (showOrganization) ...[\n'
            '            Padding(\n'
            '              padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, expanded ? 8 : 10, 14, 8),\n'
            '              child: Divider(height: 1, color: scheme.outlineVariant),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            if (expanded) const _RailGroupLabel(\'机构\'),\n'
            '            _RailItem(\n'
            '              key: const Key(\'v2-rail-organization-learning\'),\n'
            '              icon: Icons.fact_check_outlined,\n'
            '              tooltip: \'学情监督\',\n'
            '              selected:\n'
            '                  selectedDestination == V2WorkspaceDestination.organization &&\n'
            '                  organizationSection == V2OrganizationSection.learning,\n'
            '              onTap: () =>\n'
            '                  onOrganizationSelected(V2OrganizationSection.learning),\n'
            '              expanded: expanded,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            _RailItem(\n'
            '              key: const Key(\'v2-rail-organization-management\'),\n'
            '              icon: Icons.admin_panel_settings_outlined,\n'
            '              tooltip: \'管理\',\n'
            '              selected:\n'
            '                  selectedDestination == V2WorkspaceDestination.organization &&\n'
            '                  organizationSection == V2OrganizationSection.management,\n'
            '              onTap: () =>\n'
            '                  onOrganizationSelected(V2OrganizationSection.management),\n'
            '              expanded: expanded,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '          const Spacer(),\n'
            '          if (onRefresh != null)\n'
            '            _RailItem(\n'
            '              key: const Key(\'v2-workspace-refresh\'),\n'
            '              icon: Icons.refresh_outlined,\n'
            '              tooltip: refreshing ? \'正在刷新\' : \'刷新学情\',\n'
            '              onTap: refreshing ? null : onRefresh,\n'
            '              expanded: expanded,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          if (onManage != null)\n'
            '            _RailItem(\n'
            '              icon: Icons.admin_panel_settings_outlined,\n'
            '              tooltip: \'管理\',\n'
            '              onTap: onManage,\n'
            '              expanded: expanded,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          _RailItem(\n'
            '            icon: Icons.settings_outlined,\n'
            '            tooltip: \'设置\',\n'
            '            onTap: onSettings,\n'
            '            expanded: expanded,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _RailGroupLabel extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _RailGroupLabel(this.label);\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String label;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    return Padding(\n'
            '      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 12, 5),\n'
            '      child: Align(\n'
            '        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,\n'
            '        child: Text(\n'
            '          label,\n'
            '          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelSmall?.copyWith(\n'
            '            color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,\n'
            '            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '            letterSpacing: 0.3,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _RailItem extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _RailItem({\n'
            '    super.key,\n'
            '    required this.icon,\n'
            '    required this.tooltip,\n'
            '    this.selected = false,\n'
            '    this.expanded = false,\n'
            '    this.onTap,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final IconData icon;\n'
            '  final String tooltip;\n'
            '  final bool selected;\n'
            '  final bool expanded;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onTap;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    final foreground = selected ? scheme.primary : scheme.onSurfaceVariant;\n'
            '    return Padding(\n'
            '      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 3, horizontal: 10),\n'
            '      child: Tooltip(\n'
            '        message: tooltip,\n'
            '        child: AnimatedContainer(\n'
            '          duration: AppMotion.effectiveDuration(context, AppMotion.quick),\n'
            '          curve: AppMotion.enter,\n'
            '          decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '            color: selected\n'
            '                ? scheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.10)\n'
            '                : Colors.transparent,\n'
            '            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          child: Material(\n'
            '            type: MaterialType.transparency,\n'
            '            child: InkWell(\n'
            '              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),\n'
            '              onTap: onTap,\n'
            '              child: SizedBox(\n'
            '                width: expanded ? 108 : 48,\n'
            '                height: 48,\n'
            '                child: Row(\n'
            '                  mainAxisAlignment: expanded\n'
            '                      ? MainAxisAlignment.start\n'
            '                      : MainAxisAlignment.center,\n'
            '                  children: [\n'
            '                    if (expanded) const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '                    Icon(icon, size: 20, color: foreground),\n'
            '                    if (expanded) ...[\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(width: 10),\n'
            '                      Expanded(\n'
            '                        child: Text(\n'
            '                          tooltip,\n'
            '                          maxLines: 1,\n'
            '                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelMedium\n'
            '                              ?.copyWith(\n'
            '                                color: foreground,\n'
            '                                fontWeight: selected\n'
            '                                    ? FontWeight.w600\n'
            '                                    : FontWeight.w500,\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _StudentListPane extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _StudentListPane({\n'
            '    required this.selectedStudent,\n'
            '    required this.onSelected,\n'
            '    this.compact = false,\n'
            '    this.headerPadding,\n'
            '    this.onOpenMore,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2Student selectedStudent;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2Student> onSelected;\n'
            '  final bool compact;\n'
            '  final EdgeInsets? headerPadding;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onOpenMore;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_StudentListPane> createState() => _StudentListPaneState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _StudentListPaneState extends State<_StudentListPane> {\n'
            '  final _searchController = TextEditingController();\n'
            '  String _query = \'\';\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void dispose() {\n'
            '    _searchController.dispose();\n'
            '    super.dispose();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  List<V2Student> _visibleStudents(V2WorkspaceData data) {\n'
            '    final query = _query.trim().toLowerCase();\n'
            '    if (query.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      return data.students;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return data.students\n'
            '        .where((student) {\n'
            '          final haystack = [\n'
            '            student.name,\n'
            '            student.grade,\n'
            '            ...student.subjects,\n'
            '          ].join(\' \').toLowerCase();\n'
            '          return haystack.contains(query);\n'
            '        })\n'
            '        .toList(growable: false);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  void _clearSearch() {\n'
            '    _searchController.clear();\n'
            '    setState(() => _query = \'\');\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final data = V2WorkspaceDataScope.of(context);\n'
            '    final visibleStudents = _visibleStudents(data);\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    return ColoredBox(\n'
            '      color: widget.compact ? scheme.surface : scheme.surfaceContainerLowest,\n'
            '      child: Column(\n'
            '        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '        children: [\n'
            '          Padding(\n'
            '            padding:\n'
            '                widget.headerPadding ??\n'
            '                EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(\n'
            '                  widget.compact ? AppSpacing.mdPlus : AppSpacing.lg,\n'
            '                  widget.compact ? AppSpacing.mdPlus : AppSpacing.lg,\n'
            '                  AppSpacing.mdPlus,\n'
            '                  12,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '            child: Column(\n'
            '              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '              children: [\n'
            '                V2PageHeader(\n'
            '                  key: const Key(\'v2-students-page-header\'),\n'
            '                  title: \'学生\',\n'
            '                  actions: [\n'
            '                    if (widget.compact && widget.onOpenMore != null)\n'
            '                      IconButton(\n'
            '                        key: const Key(\'v2-compact-more\'),\n'
            '                        tooltip: \'更多操作\',\n'
            '                        onPressed: widget.onOpenMore,\n'
            '                        icon: const Icon(Icons.more_vert),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(height: 18),\n'
            '                TextField(\n'
            '                  key: const Key(\'v2-student-search\'),\n'
            '                  controller: _searchController,\n'
            '                  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _query = value),\n'
            '                  decoration: InputDecoration(\n'
            '                    hintText: \'搜索姓名、年级或学科…\',\n'
            '                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.search, size: 19),\n'
            '                    suffixIcon: _query.isEmpty\n'
            '                        ? null\n'
            '                        : IconButton(\n'
            '                            tooltip: \'清除搜索\',\n'
            '                            onPressed: _clearSearch,\n'
            '                            icon: const Icon(Icons.close, size: 18),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                const SizedBox(height: 14),\n'
            '                Text(\n'
            '                  _query.trim().isEmpty\n'
            '                      ? \'全部 ${data.students.length}\'\n'
            '                      : \'找到 ${visibleStudents.length} 位\',\n'
            '                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          Divider(\n'
            '            height: 1,\n'
            '            color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outlineVariant,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          Expanded(\n'
            '            child: visibleStudents.isEmpty\n'
            '                ? Center(\n'
            '                    child: Text(\n'
            '                      \'没有找到匹配的学生\',\n'
            '                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  )\n'
            '                : ListView.builder(\n'
            '                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),\n'
            '                    itemCount: visibleStudents.length,\n'
            '                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {\n'
            '                      final student = visibleStudents[index];\n'
            '                      return _StudentRow(\n'
            '                        student: student,\n'
            '                        selected:\n'
            '                            !widget.compact &&\n'
            '                            student.id == widget.selectedStudent.id,\n'
            '                        onTap: () => widget.onSelected(student),\n'
            '                      );\n'
            '                    },\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _StudentRow extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _StudentRow({\n'
            '    required this.student,\n'
            '    required this.selected,\n'
            '    required this.onTap,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2Student student;\n'
            '  final bool selected;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onTap;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    final data = V2WorkspaceDataScope.of(context);\n'
            '    return Padding(\n'
            '      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 2),\n'
            '      child: AnimatedContainer(\n'
            '        duration: AppMotion.effectiveDuration(context, AppMotion.quick),\n'
            '        curve: AppMotion.enter,\n'
            '        decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '          color: selected\n'
            '              ? scheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.07)\n'
            '              : Colors.transparent,\n'
            '          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        child: Material(\n'
            '          type: MaterialType.transparency,\n'
            '          child: InkWell(\n'
            '            onTap: onTap,\n'
            '            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(9),\n'
            '            child: Padding(\n'
            '              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),\n'
            '              child: Row(\n'
            '                children: [\n'
            '                  _InitialMark(name: student.name),\n'
            '                  const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '                  Expanded(\n'
            '                    child: Column(\n'
            '                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                      children: [\n'
            '                        Text(\n'
            '                          student.name,\n'
            '                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                        const SizedBox(height: 2),\n'
            '                        Text(\n'
            '                          \'${student.grade} · ${student.subjects.join(\' / \')}\',\n'
            '                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ],\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  const SizedBox(width: 10),\n'
            '                  Column(\n'
            '                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,\n'
            '                    children: [\n'
            '                      Text(\n'
            '                        student.openCaseCount == 0\n'
            '                            ? \'暂无进行中\'\n'
            '                            : \'${student.openCaseCount} 个进行中\',\n'
            '                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      if (student.lastActivityAt != null ||\n'
            '                          student.updatedLabel != \'暂无记录\') ...[\n'
            '                        const SizedBox(height: 3),\n'
            '                        Text(\n'
            '                          student.lastActivityAt == null\n'
            '                              ? student.updatedLabel\n'
            '                              : _recentActivityLabel(\n'
            '                                  student.lastActivityAt!,\n'
            '                                  data.businessDate,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall\n'
            '                              ?.copyWith(\n'
            '                                color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant.withValues(\n'
            '                                  alpha: 0.72,\n'
            '                                ),\n'
            '                              ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ],\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _InitialMark extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _InitialMark({required this.name});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String name;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    return Container(\n'
            '      width: 34,\n'
            '      height: 34,\n'
            '      alignment: Alignment.center,\n'
            '      decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '        color: scheme.surfaceContainer,\n'
            '        shape: BoxShape.circle,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '      child: Text(\n'
            '        name.characters.first,\n'
            '        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.labelLarge,\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _StudentDetailPane extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _StudentDetailPane({\n'
            '    required this.student,\n'
            '    required this.onOpenCase,\n'
            '    this.compact = false,\n'
            '    this.onBack,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2Student student;\n'
            '  final ValueChanged<V2FocusItem> onOpenCase;\n'
            '  final bool compact;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback? onBack;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_StudentDetailPane> createState() => _StudentDetailPaneState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _StudentDetailPaneState extends State<_StudentDetailPane> {\n'
            '  bool _showAllFocusItems = false;\n'
            '  bool _showAllTimeline = false;\n'
            '  bool _showClosedItems = false;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _StudentDetailPane oldWidget) {\n'
            '    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);\n'
            '    if (oldWidget.student.id != widget.student.id) {\n'
            '      _showAllFocusItems = false;\n'
            '      _showAllTimeline = false;\n'
            '      _showClosedItems = false;\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    final data = V2WorkspaceDataScope.of(context);\n'
            '    final focusItems = data.focusItemsForStudent(widget.student);\n'
            '    final visibleFocusItems = _showAllFocusItems\n'
            '        ? focusItems\n'
            '        : focusItems.take(_studentFocusPreviewLimit).toList(growable: false);\n'
            '    final hasAdditionalFocusItems =\n'
            '        focusItems.length > _studentFocusPreviewLimit;\n'
            '    final closedItems = data.closedItemsForStudent(widget.student);\n'
            '    final timelineEntries = data.timelineForStudent(widget.student);\n'
            '    final visibleTimelineEntries = _showAllTimeline\n'
            '        ? timelineEntries\n'
            '        : timelineEntries.take(5).toList(growable: false);\n'
            '    final hiddenTimelineCount = timelineEntries.length > 5\n'
            '        ? timelineEntries.length - 5\n'
            '        : 0;\n'
            '    return ColoredBox(\n'
            '      color: scheme.surface,\n'
            '      child: CustomScrollView(\n'
            '        slivers: [\n'
            '          SliverToBoxAdapter(\n'
            '            child: Center(\n'
            '              child: ConstrainedBox(\n'
            '                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 900),\n'
            '                child: Padding(\n'
            '                  padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(\n'
            '                    widget.compact ? 18 : 32,\n'
            '                    22,\n'
            '                    widget.compact ? 18 : 32,\n'
            '                    48,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  child: Column(\n'
            '                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                    children: [\n'
            '                      if (widget.onBack != null) ...[\n'
            '                        IconButton(\n'
            '                          tooltip: \'返回学生列表\',\n'
            '                          onPressed: widget.onBack,\n'
            '                          icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                        const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '                      ],\n'
            '                      _StudentHeader(\n'
            '                        student: widget.student,\n'
            '                        compact: widget.compact,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 30),\n'
            '                      _SectionTitle(\n'
            '                        title: _showAllFocusItems ? \'全部问题\' : \'现在最重要\',\n'
            '                        count: visibleFocusItems.length,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '                      if (focusItems.isEmpty)\n'
            '                        Padding(\n'
            '                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 18),\n'
            '                          child: Text(\n'
            '                            \'暂无进行中的问题\',\n'
            '                            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        )\n'
            '                      else ...[\n'
            '                        for (var i = 0; i < visibleFocusItems.length; i++) ...[\n'
            '                          _FocusRow(\n'
            '                            item: visibleFocusItems[i],\n'
            '                            onTap: () =>\n'
            '                                widget.onOpenCase(visibleFocusItems[i]),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          if (i < visibleFocusItems.length - 1)\n'
            '                            Divider(height: 1, color: scheme.outlineVariant),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                        if (hasAdditionalFocusItems) ...[\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(height: 6),\n'
            '                          TextButton.icon(\n'
            '                            key: const Key(\'v2-student-focus-toggle\'),\n'
            '                            onPressed: () => setState(\n'
            '                              () => _showAllFocusItems = !_showAllFocusItems,\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                            icon: Icon(\n'
            '                              _showAllFocusItems\n'
            '                                  ? Icons.expand_less\n'
            '                                  : Icons.expand_more,\n'
            '                              size: 18,\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                            label: Text(\n'
            '                              _showAllFocusItems\n'
            '                                  ? \'只看重点\'\n'
            '                                  : \'查看全部 ${focusItems.length} 个\',\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ],\n'
            '                      if (closedItems.isNotEmpty) ...[\n'
            '                        const SizedBox(height: 26),\n'
            '                        TextButton.icon(\n'
            '                          key: const Key(\'v2-student-history-toggle\'),\n'
            '                          onPressed: () => setState(\n'
            '                            () => _showClosedItems = !_showClosedItems,\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          icon: Icon(\n'
            '                            _showClosedItems\n'
            '                                ? Icons.expand_less\n'
            '                                : Icons.history_outlined,\n'
            '                            size: 18,\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          label: Text(\n'
            '                            _showClosedItems\n'
            '                                ? \'收起历史问题\'\n'
            '                                : \'查看历史问题 ${closedItems.length} 个\',\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                        if (_showClosedItems) ...[\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '                          _SectionTitle(\n'
            '                            title: \'历史问题\',\n'
            '                            count: closedItems.length,\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '                          for (var i = 0; i < closedItems.length; i++) ...[\n'
            '                            _FocusRow(\n'
            '                              item: closedItems[i],\n'
            '                              onTap: () => widget.onOpenCase(closedItems[i]),\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                            if (i < closedItems.length - 1)\n'
            '                              Divider(height: 1, color: scheme.outlineVariant),\n'
            '                          ],\n'
            '                        ],\n'
            '                      ],\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 34),\n'
            '                      const _SectionTitle(title: \'最近成长\'),\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 14),\n'
            '                      _Timeline(entries: visibleTimelineEntries),\n'
            '                      if (hiddenTimelineCount > 0) ...[\n'
            '                        const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '                        TextButton.icon(\n'
            '                          key: const Key(\'v2-student-timeline-toggle\'),\n'
            '                          onPressed: () => setState(\n'
            '                            () => _showAllTimeline = !_showAllTimeline,\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          icon: Icon(\n'
            '                            _showAllTimeline\n'
            '                                ? Icons.expand_less\n'
            '                                : Icons.expand_more,\n'
            '                            size: 18,\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                          label: Text(\n'
            '                            _showAllTimeline\n'
            '                                ? \'收起更早记录\'\n'
            '                                : \'查看更早 $hiddenTimelineCount 条\',\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ],\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _StudentHeader extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _StudentHeader({required this.student, required this.compact});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2Student student;\n'
            '  final bool compact;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final data = V2WorkspaceDataScope.of(context);\n'
            '    final focusItems = data.focusItemsForStudent(student);\n'
            '    final runtime = _V2RuntimeScope.maybeOf(context);\n'
            '    final exportStudent = runtime?.studentExport;\n'
            '    final controller = runtime?.workflowController;\n'
            '    final buttons = Wrap(\n'
            '      spacing: 8,\n'
            '      runSpacing: 8,\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        OutlinedButton.icon(\n'
            '          onPressed: () => _showV2QuickCaptureForStudent(context, student),\n'
            '          icon: const Icon(Icons.note_add_outlined, size: 18),\n'
            '          label: const Text(\'记录问题\'),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        FilledButton.icon(\n'
            '          onPressed: focusItems.isEmpty\n'
            '              ? null\n'
            '              : () => _showV2ProgressCasePicker(context, student),\n'
            '          icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_note_outlined, size: 18),\n'
            '          label: const Text(\'记进展\'),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        if (exportStudent != null || controller != null)\n'
            '          PopupMenuButton<String>(\n'
            '            key: const Key(\'v2-student-more-actions\'),\n'
            '            tooltip: \'更多操作\',\n'
            '            icon: const Icon(Icons.more_horiz),\n'
            '            onSelected: (value) async {\n'
            '              if (value == \'export\' && exportStudent != null) {\n'
            '                await exportStudent(context, student);\n'
            '              } else if (value == \'voided\' && controller != null) {\n'
            '                await _showV2VoidedCasesForStudent(context, student);\n'
            '              }\n'
            '            },\n'
            '            itemBuilder: (_) => [\n'
            '              if (exportStudent != null)\n'
            '                const PopupMenuItem<String>(\n'
            '                  value: \'export\',\n'
            '                  child: ListTile(\n'
            '                    leading: Icon(Icons.download_outlined),\n'
            '                    title: Text(\'导出学情记录\'),\n'
            '                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              if (controller != null)\n'
            '                const PopupMenuItem<String>(\n'
            '                  value: \'voided\',\n'
            '                  child: ListTile(\n'
            '                    leading: Icon(Icons.inventory_2_outlined),\n'
            '                    title: Text(\'已作废学情\'),\n'
            '                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        Text(\n'
            '          \'学生 · ${student.name}\',\n'
            '          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        const SizedBox(height: 18),\n'
            '        if (compact) ...[\n'
            '          Text(student.name, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            \'${student.grade} · ${student.subjects.join(\' / \')}\',\n'
            '            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          if (student.teacherSummary.trim().isNotEmpty) ...[\n'
            '            const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '            Text(\n'
            '              student.teacherSummary,\n'
            '              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '          buttons,\n'
            '        ] else\n'
            '          Row(\n'
            '            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '            children: [\n'
            '              Expanded(\n'
            '                child: Column(\n'
            '                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                  children: [\n'
            '                    Text(\n'
            '                      student.name,\n'
            '                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.headlineSmall,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '                    Text(\n'
            '                      \'${student.grade} · ${student.subjects.join(\' / \')}\',\n'
            '                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyLarge,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    if (student.teacherSummary.trim().isNotEmpty) ...[\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '                      Text(\n'
            '                        student.teacherSummary,\n'
            '                        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              buttons,\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _SectionTitle extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _SectionTitle({required this.title, this.count});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String title;\n'
            '  final int? count;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    return Row(\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        Text(title, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleLarge),\n'
            '        if (count != null) ...[\n'
            '          const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '          Text(\'$count\', style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _FocusRow extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _FocusRow({required this.item, required this.onTap, this.studentName});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2FocusItem item;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onTap;\n'
            '  final String? studentName;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    return InkWell(\n'
            '      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),\n'
            '      onTap: onTap,\n'
            '      child: Padding(\n'
            '        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),\n'
            '        child: Row(\n'
            '          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '          children: [\n'
            '            Container(\n'
            '              width: 2,\n'
            '              height: 58,\n'
            '              color: scheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.5),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            const SizedBox(width: 16),\n'
            '            Expanded(\n'
            '              child: Column(\n'
            '                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                children: [\n'
            '                  Text(\n'
            '                    item.title,\n'
            '                    maxLines: 2,\n'
            '                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  if (studentName != null) ...[\n'
            '                    const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '                    Text(\n'
            '                      \'$studentName · ${item.subject}\',\n'
            '                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                  if (studentName == null && _shouldShowCaseSummary(item)) ...[\n'
            '                    const SizedBox(height: 4),\n'
            '                    Text(\n'
            '                      item.summary,\n'
            '                      style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                  const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '                  Text(\n'
            '                    item.closed\n'
            '                        ? _displayNextStep(item.nextStep)\n'
            '                        : \'下一步  ${_displayNextStep(item.nextStep)}\',\n'
            '                    maxLines: 2,\n'
            '                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            if (studentName == null) ...[\n'
            '              const SizedBox(width: 16),\n'
            '              Column(\n'
            '                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,\n'
            '                children: [\n'
            '                  Text(\n'
            '                    item.subject,\n'
            '                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  const SizedBox(height: 17),\n'
            '                  Text(\n'
            '                    item.dueLabel,\n'
            '                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ],\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ] else if (!item.closed &&\n'
            '                item.dueLabel.trim().isNotEmpty &&\n'
            '                item.dueLabel != \'待安排\') ...[\n'
            '              const SizedBox(width: 12),\n'
            '              Text(item.dueLabel, style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '            const SizedBox(width: 4),\n'
            '            const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 20),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _Timeline extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _Timeline({required this.entries, this.resolveEvidencePhotos = false});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final List<V2TimelineEntry> entries;\n'
            '  final bool resolveEvidencePhotos;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    if (entries.isEmpty) {\n'
            '      return Text(\'暂时还没有成长记录\', style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium);\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++)\n'
            '          _TimelineRow(\n'
            '            entry: entries[i],\n'
            '            last: i == entries.length - 1,\n'
            '            resolveEvidencePhotos: resolveEvidencePhotos,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _TimelineRow extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _TimelineRow({\n'
            '    required this.entry,\n'
            '    required this.last,\n'
            '    required this.resolveEvidencePhotos,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2TimelineEntry entry;\n'
            '  final bool last;\n'
            '  final bool resolveEvidencePhotos;\n'
            '\n'
            '  Widget _entryBody(\n'
            '    BuildContext context, {\n'
            '    required EvidenceAttachmentRepository? attachmentRepository,\n'
            '    required bool canResolveRealPhotos,\n'
            '    required bool compact,\n'
            '  }) {\n'
            '    final theme = Theme.of(context);\n'
            '    final scheme = theme.colorScheme;\n'
            '    final meta = entry.teacher.trim().isEmpty\n'
            '        ? \'${entry.date} · ${entry.time}\'\n'
            '        : \'${entry.date} · ${entry.time} · ${entry.teacher}\';\n'
            '    return Column(\n'
            '      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        if (compact) ...[\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            meta,\n'
            '            style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(\n'
            '              color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '        Text(entry.kind, style: theme.textTheme.titleMedium),\n'
            '        if (entry.body.trim().isNotEmpty) ...[\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '          Text(entry.body, style: theme.textTheme.bodyMedium),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '        if (canResolveRealPhotos) ...[\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '          _EvidencePhotoStrip(\n'
            '            evidenceId: entry.evidenceId!,\n'
            '            repository: attachmentRepository!,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ] else if (entry.photoCount > 0) ...[\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '          _PhotoStrip(count: entry.photoCount),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '        if (!compact) ...[\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 9),\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            entry.teacher.trim().isEmpty\n'
            '                ? entry.time\n'
            '                : \'${entry.teacher} · ${entry.time}\',\n'
            '            style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(\n'
            '              color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    final attachmentRepository = _V2RuntimeScope.maybeOf(context)\n'
            '        ?.evidenceAttachmentRepository;\n'
            '    final canResolveRealPhotos =\n'
            '        resolveEvidencePhotos &&\n'
            '        entry.evidenceId != null &&\n'
            '        attachmentRepository != null;\n'
            '    final compact = ResponsiveBreakpoints.isCompact(context);\n'
            '    final lineHeight = entry.photoCount > 0 || canResolveRealPhotos\n'
            '        ? 144.0\n'
            '        : 96.0;\n'
            '    final highlighted =\n'
            '        entry.kind == \'建立跟进\' ||\n'
            '        entry.kind == \'新表现\' ||\n'
            '        entry.kind.startsWith(\'检查结果\');\n'
            '\n'
            '    if (compact) {\n'
            '      return Row(\n'
            '        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '        children: [\n'
            '          SizedBox(\n'
            '            width: 16,\n'
            '            child: Column(\n'
            '              children: [\n'
            '                Container(\n'
            '                  width: 7,\n'
            '                  height: 7,\n'
            '                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 7),\n'
            '                  decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                    color: highlighted ? scheme.primary : scheme.outline,\n'
            '                    shape: BoxShape.circle,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '                if (!last)\n'
            '                  Container(\n'
            '                    width: 1,\n'
            '                    height: lineHeight,\n'
            '                    color: scheme.outlineVariant,\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '              ],\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(width: 10),\n'
            '          Expanded(\n'
            '            child: Padding(\n'
            '              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 24),\n'
            '              child: _entryBody(\n'
            '                context,\n'
            '                attachmentRepository: attachmentRepository,\n'
            '                canResolveRealPhotos: canResolveRealPhotos,\n'
            '                compact: true,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '\n'
            '    return Row(\n'
            '      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        SizedBox(\n'
            '          width: 74,\n'
            '          child: Padding(\n'
            '            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 1),\n'
            '            child: Text(\n'
            '              entry.date,\n'
            '              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        SizedBox(\n'
            '          width: 24,\n'
            '          child: Column(\n'
            '            children: [\n'
            '              Container(\n'
            '                width: 7,\n'
            '                height: 7,\n'
            '                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 7),\n'
            '                decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '                  color: highlighted ? scheme.primary : scheme.outline,\n'
            '                  shape: BoxShape.circle,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              if (!last)\n'
            '                Container(\n'
            '                  width: 1,\n'
            '                  height: lineHeight,\n'
            '                  color: scheme.outlineVariant,\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        const SizedBox(width: 10),\n'
            '        Expanded(\n'
            '          child: Padding(\n'
            '            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 24),\n'
            '            child: _entryBody(\n'
            '              context,\n'
            '              attachmentRepository: attachmentRepository,\n'
            '              canResolveRealPhotos: canResolveRealPhotos,\n'
            '              compact: false,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Future<void> _showV2EvidencePhotoPreview(\n'
            '  BuildContext context,\n'
            '  String signedUrl,\n'
            ') {\n'
            '  final compact = ResponsiveBreakpoints.isCompact(context);\n'
            '  return showDialog<void>(\n'
            '    context: context,\n'
            '    barrierColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.86),\n'
            '    builder: (dialogContext) => Dialog(\n'
            '      insetPadding: EdgeInsets.all(compact ? 12 : 40),\n'
            '      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,\n'
            '      child: SizedBox(\n'
            '        width: compact ? double.maxFinite : 900,\n'
            '        height: compact ? MediaQuery.sizeOf(dialogContext).height * 0.82 : 680,\n'
            '        child: Stack(\n'
            '          children: [\n'
            '            Positioned.fill(\n'
            '              child: ColoredBox(\n'
            '                color: Theme.of(dialogContext).colorScheme.surface,\n'
            '                child: Center(\n'
            '                  child: InteractiveViewer(\n'
            '                    minScale: 0.5,\n'
            '                    maxScale: 5,\n'
            '                    child: Image.network(\n'
            '                      signedUrl,\n'
            '                      key: const Key(\'v2-evidence-photo-preview-image\'),\n'
            '                      fit: BoxFit.contain,\n'
            '                      loadingBuilder: (context, child, progress) {\n'
            '                        if (progress == null) return child;\n'
            '                        final expected = progress.expectedTotalBytes;\n'
            '                        final value = expected == null || expected <= 0\n'
            '                            ? null\n'
            '                            : progress.cumulativeBytesLoaded / expected;\n'
            '                        return Center(\n'
            '                          child: SizedBox(\n'
            '                            width: 34,\n'
            '                            height: 34,\n'
            '                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(value: value),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        );\n'
            '                      },\n'
            '                      errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => Padding(\n'
            '                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),\n'
            '                        child: Column(\n'
            '                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '                          children: [\n'
            '                            const Icon(Icons.broken_image_outlined, size: 36),\n'
            '                            const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '                            Text(\n'
            '                              \'图片暂时无法打开，请返回后重试。\',\n'
            '                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,\n'
            '                              style: Theme.of(dialogContext)\n'
            '                                  .textTheme\n'
            '                                  .bodyMedium,\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ],\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            Positioned(\n'
            '              top: 8,\n'
            '              right: 8,\n'
            '              child: Material(\n'
            '                color: Theme.of(dialogContext)\n'
            '                    .colorScheme\n'
            '                    .surfaceContainerHighest,\n'
            '                shape: const CircleBorder(),\n'
            '                child: IconButton(\n'
            '                  key: const Key(\'v2-evidence-photo-preview-close\'),\n'
            '                  tooltip: \'关闭图片\',\n'
            '                  onPressed: () => Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(),\n'
            '                  icon: const Icon(Icons.close),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '      ),\n'
            '    ),\n'
            '  );\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _EvidencePhotoStrip extends StatefulWidget {\n'
            '  const _EvidencePhotoStrip({\n'
            '    required this.evidenceId,\n'
            '    required this.repository,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String evidenceId;\n'
            '  final EvidenceAttachmentRepository repository;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  State<_EvidencePhotoStrip> createState() => _EvidencePhotoStripState();\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _EvidencePhotoStripState extends State<_EvidencePhotoStrip> {\n'
            '  late Future<List<String>> _signedUrls;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void initState() {\n'
            '    super.initState();\n'
            '    _signedUrls = _loadSignedUrls();\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _EvidencePhotoStrip oldWidget) {\n'
            '    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);\n'
            '    if (oldWidget.evidenceId != widget.evidenceId ||\n'
            '        oldWidget.repository != widget.repository) {\n'
            '      _signedUrls = _loadSignedUrls();\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  Future<List<String>> _loadSignedUrls() async {\n'
            '    final attachments = await widget.repository.listForEvidence(\n'
            '      widget.evidenceId,\n'
            '    );\n'
            '    final result = <String>[];\n'
            '    for (final attachment in attachments.take(3)) {\n'
            '      result.add(\n'
            '        await widget.repository.createSignedUrl(attachment.storagePath),\n'
            '      );\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return List<String>.unmodifiable(result);\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    return FutureBuilder<List<String>>(\n'
            '      future: _signedUrls,\n'
            '      builder: (context, snapshot) {\n'
            '        if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {\n'
            '          return Row(\n'
            '            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,\n'
            '            children: [\n'
            '              const SizedBox(\n'
            '                width: 14,\n'
            '                height: 14,\n'
            '                child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 1.5),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              const SizedBox(width: 8),\n'
            '              Text(\'正在加载图片…\', style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        if (snapshot.hasError) {\n'
            '          return Text(\n'
            '            \'图片暂时无法加载\',\n'
            '            style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall\n'
            '                ?.copyWith(color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        final urls = snapshot.data ?? const <String>[];\n'
            '        if (urls.isEmpty) {\n'
            '          return const SizedBox.shrink();\n'
            '        }\n'
            '        return Wrap(\n'
            '          spacing: 8,\n'
            '          runSpacing: 8,\n'
            '          children: [\n'
            '            for (var index = 0; index < urls.length; index++)\n'
            '              Semantics(\n'
            '                button: true,\n'
            '                label: \'查看图片 ${index + 1}\',\n'
            '                child: Material(\n'
            '                  color: Colors.transparent,\n'
            '                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(7),\n'
            '                  child: InkWell(\n'
            '                    key: ValueKey<String>(\'v2-evidence-photo-$index\'),\n'
            '                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(7),\n'
            '                    onTap: () =>\n'
            '                        _showV2EvidencePhotoPreview(context, urls[index]),\n'
            '                    child: ClipRRect(\n'
            '                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(7),\n'
            '                      child: SizedBox(\n'
            '                        width: 96,\n'
            '                        height: 72,\n'
            '                        child: Image.network(\n'
            '                          urls[index],\n'
            '                          fit: BoxFit.cover,\n'
            '                          errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => ColoredBox(\n'
            '                            color: scheme.surfaceContainer,\n'
            '                            child: Icon(\n'
            '                              Icons.broken_image_outlined,\n'
            '                              color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,\n'
            '                            ),\n'
            '                          ),\n'
            '                        ),\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '          ],\n'
            '        );\n'
            '      },\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _PhotoStrip extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _PhotoStrip({required this.count});\n'
            '\n'
            '  final int count;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;\n'
            '    return Wrap(\n'
            '      spacing: 8,\n'
            '      runSpacing: 8,\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        for (var i = 0; i < count.clamp(0, 3); i++)\n'
            '          Container(\n'
            '            width: 86,\n'
            '            height: 66,\n'
            '            decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '              color: scheme.surfaceContainer,\n'
            '              border: Border.all(color: scheme.outlineVariant),\n'
            '              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(7),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '            child: Icon(\n'
            '              Icons.description_outlined,\n'
            '              color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant.withValues(alpha: 0.7),\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'class _CaseDetailPane extends StatelessWidget {\n'
            '  const _CaseDetailPane({\n'
            '    required this.student,\n'
            '    required this.item,\n'
            '    required this.onBack,\n'
            '    this.compact = false,\n'
            '  });\n'
            '\n'
            '  final V2Student student;\n'
            '  final V2FocusItem item;\n'
            '  final VoidCallback onBack;\n'
            '  final bool compact;\n'
            '\n'
            '  String get _statusLabel {\n'
            '    switch (item.effectiveStatus) {\n'
            '      case V2CaseStatus.newCase:\n'
            '        return \'新记录\';\n'
            '      case V2CaseStatus.confirmed:\n'
            '      case V2CaseStatus.intervening:\n'
            '        return \'跟进中\';\n'
            '      case V2CaseStatus.pendingVerification:\n'
            '        return \'待复检\';\n'
            '      case V2CaseStatus.stable:\n'
            '        return \'暂时稳定\';\n'
            '      case V2CaseStatus.closed:\n'
            '        return \'已结束\';\n'
            '    }\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  String _primaryActionLabel(V2PendingActionSnapshot? pendingAction) {\n'
            '    if (item.pendingVerification) return \'记录复检\';\n'
            '    if (pendingAction != null && !pendingAction.canComplete) {\n'
            '      return \'确认并跟进\';\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    return \'记进展\';\n'
            '  }\n'
            '\n'
            '  IconData get _primaryActionIcon => item.pendingVerification\n'
            '      ? Icons.fact_check_outlined\n'
            '      : Icons.edit_note_outlined;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n'
            '    final theme = Theme.of(context);\n'
            '    final scheme = theme.colorScheme;\n'
            '    final timelineEntries = V2WorkspaceDataScope.of(context)\n'
            '        .timelineForCase(item);\n'
            '    final controller = _V2RuntimeScope.maybeOf(context)?.workflowController;\n'
            '    final pendingAction = item.closed\n'
            '        ? null\n'
            '        : controller?.pendingActionFor(item.id);\n'
            '    final canReopen =\n'
            '        item.closed && (controller?.canReopenClosedCase(item.id) ?? false);\n'
            '    final showJudgment = _shouldShowCaseSummary(item);\n'
            '    final nextStep = _displayNextStep(item.nextStep);\n'
            '    final dueText = item.dueLabel.trim().isEmpty || item.dueLabel == \'待安排\'\n'
            '        ? \'尚未安排时间\'\n'
            '        : \'计划 ${item.dueLabel}\';\n'
            '\n'
            '    final identity = Column(\n'
            '      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '      children: [\n'
            '        Container(\n'
            '          key: ValueKey<String>(\'v2-case-status-${item.id}\'),\n'
            '          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),\n'
            '          decoration: BoxDecoration(\n'
            '            color: item.pendingVerification\n'
            '                ? scheme.primaryContainer.withValues(alpha: 0.55)\n'
            '                : scheme.surfaceContainerHighest,\n'
            '            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          child: Text(\n'
            '            _statusLabel,\n'
            '            style: theme.textTheme.labelMedium?.copyWith(\n'
            '              color: item.pendingVerification\n'
            '                  ? scheme.onPrimaryContainer\n'
            '                  : scheme.onSurfaceVariant,\n'
            '              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        const SizedBox(height: 10),\n'
            '        Text(\n'
            '          item.title,\n'
            '          style: theme.textTheme.headlineSmall?.copyWith(\n'
            '            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '            height: 1.25,\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '        ),\n'
            '        if (showJudgment) ...[\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 16),\n'
            '          Text(\n'
            '            \'当前判断\',\n'
            '            style: theme.textTheme.labelMedium?.copyWith(\n'
            '              color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,\n'
            '              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,\n'
            '            ),\n'
            '          ),\n'
            '          const SizedBox(height: 5),\n'
            '          Text(item.summary, style: theme.textTheme.bodyLarge),\n'
            '        ],\n'
            '      ],\n'
            '    );\n'
            '\n'
            '    final primaryButton = item.closed\n'
            '        ? null\n'
            '        : FilledButton.icon(\n'
            '            key: ValueKey<String>(\'v2-case-primary-${item.id}\'),\n'
            '            onPressed: () => _showV2ProgressForCase(context, student, item),\n'
            '            icon: Icon(_primaryActionIcon, size: 18),\n'
            '            label: Text(_primaryActionLabel(pendingAction)),\n'
            '          );\n'
            '\n'
            '    final moreMenu = controller == null\n'
            '        ? null\n'
            '        : PopupMenuButton<String>(\n'
            '            key: ValueKey<String>(\'v2-case-more-${item.id}\'),\n'
            '            tooltip: \'更多操作\',\n'
            '            icon: const Icon(Icons.more_vert),\n'
            '            onSelected: (value) async {\n'
            '              if (value != \'void\') return;\n'
            '              final removed = await _showV2VoidCase(context, student, item);\n'
            '              if (removed && context.mounted) onBack();\n'
            '            },\n'
            '            itemBuilder: (menuContext) => [\n'
            '              PopupMenuItem<String>(\n'
            '                key: ValueKey<String>(\'v2-void-${item.id}\'),\n'
            '                value: \'void\',\n'
            '                child: Row(\n'
            '                  children: [\n'
            '                    Icon(\n'
            '                      Icons.hide_source_outlined,\n'
            '                      size: 18,\n'
            '                      color: Theme.of(menuContext).colorScheme.error,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                    const SizedBox(width: 10),\n'
            '                    Text(\n'
            '                      \'作废错误学情\',\n'
            '                      style: TextStyle(\n'
            '                        color: Theme.of(menuContext).colorScheme.error,\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ],\n'
            '                ),\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '            ],\n'
            '          );\n'
            '\n'
            '    return ColoredBox(\n'
            '      color: scheme.surface,\n'
            '      child: SingleChildScrollView(\n'
            '        child: Center(\n'
            '          child: ConstrainedBox(\n'
            '            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 860),\n'
            '            child: Padding(\n'
            '              padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(\n'
            '                compact ? 18 : 32,\n'
            '                20,\n'
            '                compact ? 18 : 32,\n'
            '                48,\n'
            '              ),\n'
            '              child: Column(\n'
            '                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                children: [\n'
            '                  IconButton(\n'
            '                    tooltip: \'返回\',\n'
            '                    onPressed: onBack,\n'
            '                    icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  const SizedBox(height: 8),\n'
            '                  Text(\n'
            '                    \'${student.name} · ${item.subject}\',\n'
            '                    maxLines: 2,\n'
            '                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,\n'
            '                    style: theme.textTheme.bodySmall?.copyWith(\n'
            '                      color: scheme.onSurfaceVariant,\n'
            '                    ),\n'
            '                  ),\n'
            '                  const SizedBox(height: 12),\n'
            '                  if (compact) ...[\n'
            '                    identity,\n'
            '                    if (primaryButton != null || moreMenu != null) ...[\n'
            '                      const SizedBox(height: 18),\n'
            '                      Wrap(\n'
            '                        spacing: 8,\n'
            '                        runSpacing: 8,\n'
            '                        crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,\n'
            '                        children: [?primaryButton, ?moreMenu],\n'
            '                      ),\n'
            '                    ],\n'
            '                  ] else\n'
            '                    Row(\n'
            '                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,\n'
            '                      children: [\n'
            '                        Expanded(child: identity),\n'
            '                        if (primaryButton != null) ...[\n'
            '                          const SizedBox(width: 20),\n'
            '                          primaryButton,\n'
